dictionary.lore: Originally, they were normal earrings that belonged to a noble's daughter. However, one day the young daughter lost her life when she was attacked by a dragon. Enraged, her lover put on her earrings and set off to drench himself in the blood of the dragon. The earrings became the fuel for the lover's revenge. His thoughts focused only on slaying the dragon ignited the fighting instinct within him.
